text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon comes running over excitedly, 
telling me that the lyrics for her live 
performance song are finally finished!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello then asks you to help her come 
up with a title for the song. What kind of 
words should you dedicate to the 
Umamusume—?
